title: DISTRIBUTED MESSAGE QUEUE
subtitle: Don't delete on read: an append-only log is fast and replayable.
footer: DDIA: Ch 12 log-based brokers · Ch 6 replication · Ch 10 consensus   ·   Similar: Key-value store · Ad click aggregator

items: Partitions = append-only logs read by offset
Leader + followers; acks=all to the ISR; Raft controller with epochs
Consumer groups commit offsets; retention or compaction

blocks.text: hash(key) picks the partition; groups read independently at their own offsets.
In-memory queue: one machine, crash loses data, no replay.

items: Commit after processing = at-least-once; idempotent consumers or transactions for exactly-once effects.

blocks.text: "Each topic is partitioned into append-only logs replicated to the in-sync replicas with acks=all; consumers in a group split partitions and commit offsets after processing, so they can resume, replay, and other teams read the same data independently."
